title: Pair of scissors with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handles (orange rings) -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='13' fill='#ff8c00' stroke='#ffd27f' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='78' r='13' fill='#ff8c00' stroke='#ffd27f' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- blades pivoting near center -->
  <polygon points='52,50 14,22 22,30 56,54' fill='#9fd8ff' stroke='#e8f6ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <polygon points='48,50 86,22 78,30 44,54' fill='#cfeaff' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- blade tips -->
  <polygon points='14,22 4,10 18,16' fill='#9fd8ff' stroke='#e8f6ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <polygon points='86,22 96,10 82,16' fill='#cfeaff' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- connecting stems from blades to handles -->
  <polygon points='50,52 30,68 38,74 52,58' fill='#ffd27f' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 70,68 62,74 48,58' fill='#ffd27f' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='5' fill='#ffe9b0' stroke='#ff8c00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the blades area -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='12' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='2.2' fill='#d94f00'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='37' r='2.2' fill='#d94f00'/>
  <path d='M43 44 Q50 50 57 44' fill='none' stroke='#d94f00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='43' r='2' fill='#ff9e6e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='2' fill='#ff9e6e'/>
</svg>
